bound_derivation: Slice update: one full destination buffer plus at most two update reshape buffers and one update dtype conversion. Full replacement and empty updates may alias retained input backing; no donation is assumed.
Row-contiguous materialization: at most one logical output buffer, otherwise input backing is retained. Covers arbitrary strides and native compaction of oversized input buffers.
Deep copy: independent logical output plus possible CPU stride-compaction buffer. Both use the retained shared Metal allocator, counted once rather than as separate CPU/GPU residency.
Each capacity includes vendored Metal page rounding and bounded oversized cache reuse. All new intermediates are charged through the completed span.

native_measurement.oracle: exact independent host logical ordering and rectangular replacement, checked after peak capture
